resolutions.evidence: `tasks.md` 9.5 runs `npx pi --no-session --help` in the copy with no `settings.json` `packages` entry and no `PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR`; Pi loads packages only from the agent directory's settings (first change design Decision 6; archived `tasks.md` 6.1–6.4 recipe, measured green with two controls). Without the entry nothing from the copy loads, so `Failed to load extension` can never appear; with Joel's real `~/.pi/agent/settings.json` in play the run exercises the live checkout instead.
resolutions.rationale: Valid and blocking: the check cannot fail and may touch the live checkout. The settled recipe exists verbatim in the archived first change and needs no install.
resolutions.required_change: Replace 9.5 with the foundation recipe, run in one shell session from the repository root after the group-9 commit: `R=$(pwd); D=$(mktemp -d); git archive HEAD | tar -x -C "$D"; cd "$D"; printf '{"packages":[%s]}' "$(node -p 'JSON.stringify(process.argv[1])' "$D")" > "$D/settings.json"; PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR="$D" pi --no-session --help > out.txt 2>&1; head -1 out.txt; rg -c 'Failed to load extension|Host-provided extension packages' out.txt`. Pass: `head -1` prints Pi's usage header (proof Pi ran) and `rg -c` prints nothing (exit 1). Control: in `$D/src/infra/pi-event-handlers/session-start.ts` replace the body with `throw new Error("control");`, re-run the `pi` line, require `rg -c 'Failed to load extension' out.txt` to print `1`, then undo with `git -C "$R" archive HEAD | tar -x -C "$D"` and re-run to confirm the clean result. Finish with `cd "$R"; rm -rf "$D"; git status --short` empty. Drop the `node_modules` symlink and `npx`; record `pi --version` (1.5.2). Never assert on the exit code.
